sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:46

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:46:1
items.html:
All the Partzufim are so, for the NHY of the upper one, their externality, become the garment for the Mochin of the Partzuf below it, and everything enters and spreads in the Rosh and the Guf of that lower Partzuf: This has already been explained well above (page 637, the passage beginning “Now”); study it there well. The matter of the NHY of the upper one that clothe in the lower one is that they are the NHY of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh, which emerge in the Rosh of the upper one by force of the inclusion of the lower one in the coupling of the Rosh of the upper one. These additional NHY are not at all the NHY of the ten Sefirot of the upper one, since they are below his level. For example, the NHY of the Rosh of Atik are the NHY of the level of Keter, but the NHY that were added in Atik because of the inclusion of AA there as MAN [Mayin Nukvin] are the NHY of the level of Hochma, as above. And this is what the ARI is precise about in saying “their externality becomes the garment of the Mochin for the Partzuf below,” for the level of phase three is called externality with respect to the level of phase four, and AA took only the NHY of phase three; hence he took only the externality of the NHY of Atik. And in this way all the Partzufim do not take the actual NHY of the upper one, but the NHY of the level of the lower one at the time when it is included in the upper one, which is always one degree lower than the upper one, and for this reason it is called the externality of the upper one, or the posterior of the NHY of the upper one. Remember this.
Now these NHY of the upper one become a garment for the Mochin of the lower one, and they descend with him when he leaves the Rosh of the upper one for his own place, for the substance of the light of the level clothes in these NHY, and the NHY clothe together with the Mochin in the vessels of the lower one, so that these NHY are an intermediate between the lights of the lower one and the vessels of the lower one.
Know also that in these NHY there are complete ten Sefirot of Rosh and Guf, just as there are in the Mochin that they receive within them. For Netzah and Hod are the vessels of the GAR [first three], and the HBD of the Mochin clothe in them; and Yesod is the vessel for all the ZAT of the Mochin, which are HGT NHYM, as will be written below.
